hotel.name: InterContinental Phu Quoc Long Beach Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is on the tropical Vietnamese island of Phu Quoc, where the ocean meets jungle-clad hills.
verified_facts.excerpt: located on the tropical Vietnamese island of Phu Quoc. Where the azure ocean meets jungle-clad hills

verified_facts.text: Phu Quoc International Airport is about 12 kilometers from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Phu Quoc International Airport (PQC), approximately 7.46 miles away (12 kilometers) from the hotel

verified_facts.text: All accommodations have views of the ocean, the green mountains, gardens or lagoons.
verified_facts.excerpt: all our accommodations feature extraordinary views of the sparkling ocean, vivid green mountains, lush gardens, or lagoons

verified_facts.text: Accommodation spans rooms and suites in the resort wings, residences in the Sky Tower and beachfront villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: the elegantly-appointed rooms and suites in our resort wings, the spacious residences in the Sky Tower, or the exclusive beachfront villas

verified_facts.text: The Four Bedroom Villa may include an outdoor private pool, oceanfront position and beach access.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Four Bedroom Villa may include:

- Outdoor Private Pool
- Outdoor Living Area
- Oceanfront

verified_facts.text: HARNN Heritage Spa has treatment suites that appear to float on the Lotus Lagoon, with therapies inspired by traditional Asian healing.
verified_facts.excerpt: HARNN Heritage Spa – 2025 Haute Grandeur Global Awards - Certified Spa is a place of natural serenity offering guests a unique and luxurious wellness experience inspired through the long tradition of healing Asian therapies

verified_facts.text: The resort has two main outdoor pools for adults, two children's pools with water slides, and a pool for Club InterContinental guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: from two main outdoor pools for adults to two outdoor pools with water slides for children and toddlers, to one exclusive outdoor pool for Club InterContinental guests

verified_facts.text: INK 360, the rooftop bar designed by Ashley Sutton, has panoramic ocean views from the 19th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: the iconic INK 360 is designed by Ashley Sutton and boasts unparalleled panoramic views of the sparkling ocean from the 19th floor

verified_facts.text: LAVA restaurant has a facade built from local materials by architect Vo Trong Nghia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring a striking facade built from local materials by one of the most celebrated advocates of sustainability in Asia, architect Vo Trong Nghia

verified_facts.text: Sea Shack is a beachfront restaurant inspired by the architecture of local fishing villages, with live music, BBQ and tiki cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sea Shack, a breezy beachfront restaurant inspired by the traditional architecture of local fishing villages

verified_facts.text: Kids services include children's activities on site, babysitting and a nanny for hire.
verified_facts.excerpt:
#### Kids activities and services
- Babysitting
- Children's activities onsite
- Nanny for hire

verified_facts.text: The beach has chairs, umbrellas, towel service and cabanas for rent.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Beach chairs
Cabanas (for rent)
Towel service
Umbrellas

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is included with a stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breakfast is free with your stay at the InterContinental Phu Quoc Long Beach Resort.

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds EDGE Advanced third-party sustainability certification.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Our hotel has a third-party sustainability certification.
**Certifications: EDGE Advanced**

verified_facts.text: Beachfront wedding ceremonies can be planned at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Plan your wedding ceremony set within beautiful tropical beachfront surroundings and azure ocean horizons

verified_facts.text: Ho Quoc Pagoda is a 30-minute drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ho Quoc Pagoda 30 minutes drive from the resort.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed in the resort.
